instruction: Read the patient chart in the source. Draft the visit note for this patient's visit scheduled in the reporting period, in SOAP form (Subjective / Objective / Assessment / Plan). Carry the previous note's Plan forward and update it: anything in 'recent events' must be reflected in Assessment and Plan, and anything the nurse must verify on arrival goes first in Plan as a checklist. Leave Objective as labelled blanks for vitals to be filled in at the bedside — never invent a measurement. Begin the draft with the patient code P-001 and the visit date. This draft saves the nurse the blank-page start; the nurse rewrites and signs — the draft is never the record.
description: The draft is in SOAP form for the visit in the reporting period, every item in 'recent events' is reflected, and Objective contains no invented measurements.
